### Events

| Name              | Payload | Description                                                                                                                                                                                |
| ----------------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `refresh`         | —       | User clicked the Refresh item in the overflow action menu. Payload: `{ title }` where `title` is the widget's display title (consumers route by it when one handler serves many wrappers). |
| `request-feature` | —       | User clicked the Request a feature item. Payload: `{ title }` — the widget's display title.                                                                                                |
